hierarchy_levels.LEVEL_2: GT-informed diagnostic replay (e.g. V19 R4/R5 using FN-mined proposals). Not autonomous.
hierarchy_levels.LEVEL_3: Autonomous video inference on development cohort (gC-14, gZ-36, gB-9). Full video, zero oracle info.
hierarchy_levels.LEVEL_4: Locked independent holdout validation (>=5 fresh subjects, zero exposure, single-shot evaluation).
